_comment: Pinned image digests for reproducible builds. Every entry is a REGISTRY MANIFEST digest (the only digest `docker pull repo@sha256:...` accepts), recorded from pushed builds only: `crewhaus build-image --push` records here by default (opt out with --no-record), and the Release workflow's docker-digests job records the pushed ghcr.io/crewhaus/<target> digests for each v* tag. Local --load builds record nothing — a local image ID is a config digest, not a pullable pin. Format: `{ "<target>": { "<tag>": { "sha256": "<digest>", "builtAt": "<iso>" } } }`.
